fields.recommendation: Redesign: the graded value equals a constant that the panel label and the lesson both print. Removing '(plant 2.5)' from the tile label would not fix it, because lesson l02:9 also states it. The owner can either accept it as a free recover-the-plant check or replace it as proposed.
fields.evidence: The fit runs on a noiseless grid sampled from the design Corey set, so it recovers its own plant: 2.4999999999999996. The tile label itself reads 'Fitted nw (plant 2.5)' (DesignExplorer.jsx:116) and the lesson says '2.5 written from the design table passes equally well' (l02:9); the beginner panel's nw slider also defaults to 2.5.
fields.notes: Guess estimate: Corey exponents 1 to 4 in halves = 7 values, 1 within tol (guess_p 0.14), but no guess is needed since 2.5 is printed beside the tile. LEAK (by design): default fit mode prints 2.50000000000.
